subject: maths
prompt_en: For a 'how many more' question, guess first: will we add the two numbers, or find the gap between them?
prompt_hi: 'Kitne zyada' wale sawaal mein pehle guess karo: dono numbers jodenge, ya unke beech ka antar nikaalenge?
answer: Find the gap: take the smaller from the bigger

subject: maths
prompt_en: To find how many more 785 is than 563, why do we take 563 from 785 and not 785 from 563?
prompt_hi: 785, 563 se kitna zyada hai, yeh nikaalne ke liye hum 785 mein se 563 kyun ghatate hain, 563 mein se 785 kyun nahi?
answer: We want the extra part of the bigger count beyond the smaller one, so it is bigger minus smaller; 563 does not have 785 to take away

subject: maths
prompt_en: Karnataka has 563 tigers and Uttarakhand has 560. Question 1: how many in both together? Question 2: how many more in Karnataka? Answer both.
prompt_hi: Karnataka mein 563 bagh aur Uttarakhand mein 560. Sawaal 1: dono milake kitne? Sawaal 2: Karnataka mein kitne zyada? Dono ka jawaab do.
answer: Together 1123; Karnataka has 3 more

subject: maths
prompt_en: A school has 1245 girls and 1180 boys. How many more girls than boys?
prompt_hi: Ek school mein 1245 ladkiyan aur 1180 ladke hain. Ladkon se kitni zyada ladkiyan hain?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Question: how many more is 702 than 458? I worked column by column taking the smaller digit from the bigger: 8 − 2 = 6, 5 − 0 = 5, 7 − 4 = 3, so 356. Is that right?
prompt_hi: Sawaal: 702, 458 se kitna zyada hai? Maine har column mein bade digit mein se chhota ghataya: 8 − 2 = 6, 5 − 0 = 5, 7 − 4 = 3, toh 356. Kya yeh sahi hai?
answer: No. It is 702 − 458 = 244; we must take the bottom digit from the top digit and borrow

subject: maths
prompt_en: Show the comparison on a number line: start at 444 and jump to 785. How long is the jump?
prompt_hi: Number line pe comparison dikhao: 444 se 785 tak jump lagao. Jump kitni lambi hai?

subject: maths
prompt_en: A wildlife park had 1240 deer last year and 1385 this year. Did the number go up or down, and by how much?
prompt_hi: Ek wildlife park mein pichhle saal 1240 hiran the aur is saal 1385. Ginti badhi ya ghati, aur kitni?
answer: Up, by 145

subject: maths
prompt_en: Arrange these counts from biggest to smallest: 785, 1023, 560.
prompt_hi: In ginti ko sabse bade se sabse chhote tak lagao: 785, 1023, 560.

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach Golu how to answer 'how many more' questions from a table.
prompt_hi: Golu ko sikhao table se 'kitne zyada' wale sawaal kaise karte hain.
answer: Find the two counts, decide which is bigger, take the smaller from the bigger (lining up and borrowing), and check by adding the answer to the smaller count

subject: maths
prompt_en: Quick! How many more is 900 than 650?
prompt_hi: Jaldi batao! 900, 650 se kitna zyada hai?

subject: maths
prompt_en: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
prompt_hi: Ek square mein symmetry ki kitni lines hoti hain?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Does the letter A have a line of symmetry? Where is it?
prompt_hi: Kya letter A mein symmetry ki line hai? Kahan hai?
answer: Yes, one standing line down the middle

subject: maths
prompt_en: Guess before folding: a rectangle of paper that is not a square, folded corner to corner. Will the two halves match exactly?
prompt_hi: Fold karne se pehle guess karo: ek rectangle kaagaz jo square nahi hai, corner se corner fold kiya. Kya dono hisse bilkul mel khayenge?
answer: No; the corners stick out, so the diagonal is not a line of symmetry

subject: maths
prompt_en: You said a rectangle has 2 lines of symmetry. Why is the corner-to-corner line not one of them?
prompt_hi: Tumne kaha rectangle mein symmetry ki 2 lines hain. Corner se corner wali line inmein kyun nahi hai?
answer: Folded along it, the halves do not lie exactly on top of each other; they are equal in size but not mirror images

subject: maths
prompt_en: Letters H and F. Which has more lines of symmetry?
prompt_hi: Letter H aur F. Kisme symmetry ki zyada lines hain?
answer: H: it has 2 lines; F has none

subject: maths
prompt_en: How many lines of symmetry does a triangle with all sides equal have?
prompt_hi: Jis triangle ki teeno sides barabar hain, usmein symmetry ki kitni lines hain?

subject: maths
prompt_en: I said every shape has exactly one line of symmetry. Check me with a circle and with the letter S.
prompt_hi: Maine kaha har shape mein symmetry ki sirf ek line hoti hai. Ek circle aur letter S se mujhe check karo.
answer: Wrong. A circle has endless lines of symmetry, and S has none

subject: maths
prompt_en: Picture a toran flag: a triangle pointing down, hanging from a string, with its two slanting sides equal. Where is its line of symmetry?
prompt_hi: Ek toran ka jhanda socho: neeche ki taraf nok wala triangle jo dhaage se latka hai, aur uski do tirchi sides barabar hain. Uski symmetry ki line kahan hai?
answer: A standing line from the middle of the top edge down to the bottom point

subject: maths
prompt_en: Think of the Indian flag with its three bands and the chakra in the centre. How many lines of symmetry does it have, counting the colours?
prompt_hi: 3 rangon wale Bharat ke jhande ke baare mein socho, beech mein chakra hai. Rangon ko dhyaan mein rakhkar, uski symmetry ki kitni lines hain?
answer: 1: the standing line through the middle of the chakra; a lying line does not work because saffron and green would swap

subject: maths
prompt_en: A square cut corner to corner and a long rectangle cut corner to corner both give two equal triangles. In which one do the halves fold exactly on top of each other?
prompt_hi: Ek square ko corner se corner kaata aur ek lambe rectangle ko bhi corner se corner. Dono mein do barabar triangle bane. Kisme dono hisse fold karne pe bilkul ek doosre pe aate hain?
answer: The square

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach Golu how to check whether a shape has a line of symmetry.
prompt_hi: Golu ko sikhao kaise check karein ki kisi shape mein symmetry ki line hai ya nahi.
answer: Fold the shape along the line (or hold a mirror on it); if one half lies exactly on the other with nothing sticking out, it is a line of symmetry; try other directions too

subject: maths
prompt_en: Quick! How many lines of symmetry does a circle have?
prompt_hi: Jaldi batao! Circle mein symmetry ki kitni lines hoti hain?
answer: Endless (very many)

subject: maths
prompt_en: A dot is 2 squares to the left of a standing mirror line. Where does its mirror dot go?
prompt_hi: Ek dot khadi mirror line se 2 square left mein hai. Uska mirror dot kahan jaayega?
answer: 2 squares to the right of the line

subject: maths
prompt_en: A point is 4 squares to the right of a standing mirror line, in the bottom row. Where is its mirror point?
prompt_hi: Ek point khadi mirror line se 4 square right mein hai, sabse neeche wali row mein. Uska mirror point kahan hai?
answer: 4 squares to the left of the line, in the bottom row

subject: maths
prompt_en: An arrow points to the left, away from a standing mirror line. Guess: in the mirror half, which way will the arrow point?
prompt_hi: Ek arrow left ki taraf hai, khadi mirror line se door. Guess karo: mirror wale hisse mein arrow kis taraf hoga?
answer: To the right, away from the line

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why must a mirror dot be the same number of squares from the line as the original dot?
prompt_hi: Mirror dot, asli dot jitne hi square line se door kyun hona chahiye?
answer: Folding along the line puts each dot exactly on top of its mirror dot, so both must be the same distance from the line

subject: maths
prompt_en: Half of a rangoli has a flower at the top left, near a standing mirror line. Ria draws its mirror at the top right, near the line. Sam draws it at the bottom right. Who is right?
prompt_hi: Rangoli ke aadhe hisse mein upar left, khadi mirror line ke paas, ek phool hai. Ria uska mirror upar right, line ke paas banati hai. Sam neeche right banata hai. Kaun sahi hai?
answer: Ria

subject: maths
prompt_en: Now the mirror line is lying flat. A dot is 3 squares above it. Where does its mirror dot go?
prompt_hi: Ab mirror line leti hui hai. Ek dot usse 3 square upar hai. Uska mirror dot kahan jaayega?
answer: 3 squares below the line, straight down

subject: maths
prompt_en: A dot is 1 square to the left of the line. I drew its mirror 3 squares to the right. Is that right?
prompt_hi: Ek dot line se 1 square left mein hai. Maine uska mirror 3 square right mein banaya. Kya yeh sahi hai?
answer: No. It should be 1 square to the right

subject: maths
prompt_en: Only the left half of a capital A and the middle mirror line are shown. Say in words how to complete it.
prompt_hi: Capital A ka sirf left wala aadha hissa aur beech ki mirror line dikh rahi hai. Shabdon mein batao ise kaise poora karein.
answer: Draw a slanting line from the top down to the right, the mirror of the left side, and finish the other half of the crossbar the same length

subject: maths
prompt_en: A rangoli has a standing line and a lying line of symmetry. One diya is drawn in the top-left part. How many diyas will the complete rangoli have, and where?
prompt_hi: Ek rangoli mein symmetry ki ek khadi line aur ek leti line hai. Upar-left hisse mein ek diya bana hai. Poori rangoli mein kitne diye honge, aur kahan?
answer: 4: top-left, top-right, bottom-left and bottom-right

subject: maths
prompt_en: To complete a heart from its left half, Ravi copied the same half and slid it to the right without flipping it. Will it make a heart?
prompt_hi: Dil ka left wala aadha hissa poora karne ke liye Ravi ne wahi hissa copy karke bina palte right mein khiska diya. Kya dil banega?
answer: No. The half must be flipped; slid across, its curves face the wrong way

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach Golu how to complete half a picture on a grid across a mirror line.
prompt_hi: Golu ko sikhao grid pe mirror line ke paar aadhi picture kaise poori karein.
answer: Pick a corner point, count squares from it to the mirror line, count the same number on the other side straight across, mark it; do this for every corner point and join them; points on the line stay put

subject: maths
prompt_en: Quick! A dot is ON the mirror line. Where is its mirror dot?
prompt_hi: Jaldi batao! Ek dot mirror line ke UPAR hi hai. Uska mirror dot kahan hai?
answer: In the same place, on the line

subject: maths
prompt_en: The hour hand is just past 7 and the minute hand points to 4. What time is it?
prompt_hi: Ghante ki sui 7 se thoda aage hai aur minute ki sui 4 pe. Kya time hua?

subject: maths
prompt_en: School starts at 8 in the morning. Is that 8 a.m. or 8 p.m.?
prompt_hi: School subah 8 baje shuru hota hai. Woh 8 a.m. hai ya 8 p.m.?
answer: 8 a.m.

subject: maths
prompt_en: The minute hand is on 9 and the hour hand is between 2 and 3, close to 3. Guess: is it 3:45 or 2:45?
prompt_hi: Minute ki sui 9 pe hai aur ghante ki sui 2 aur 3 ke beech, 3 ke paas. Guess karo: 3:45 hai ya 2:45?

subject: maths
prompt_en: You said the minute hand on 8 means 40 minutes. Why not 8 minutes?
prompt_hi: Tumne kaha minute ki sui 8 pe matlab 40 minute. 8 minute kyun nahi?
answer: For the minute hand, each number is 5 minutes after the one before, so 8 numbers is 8 × 5 = 40 minutes

subject: maths
prompt_en: 12 noon and 12 midnight: which one is 12 p.m. and which one is 12 a.m.?
prompt_hi: Dopahar 12 baje aur aadhi raat 12 baje: kaunsa 12 p.m. hai aur kaunsa 12 a.m.?
answer: 12 noon is 12 p.m. and 12 midnight is 12 a.m.

subject: maths
prompt_en: A railway board says a train leaves at 6:35 p.m. Is that in the morning or in the evening? Where will the minute hand be?
prompt_hi: Railway board pe likha hai train 6:35 p.m. pe chhootegi. Woh subah hai ya shaam? Minute ki sui kahan hogi?
answer: In the evening; the minute hand will be on 7
